cases.name: Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc.
UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Suno is an AI music generation company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, MA. According to its website, Suno offers an AI music generator that creates complete original songs including vocals, lyrics, and full production from text prompts in under a minute, across multiple genres. The company describes its core product as a web-based tool where users can describe desired songs by genre, mood, theme, or lyrics, and generate full tracks. Suno also offers Suno Studio, described as a first-of-its-kind web-based generative audio workstation combining traditional DAW functionality with AI-powered music creation.

Suno provides free access to its music generation capabilities and offers paid tiers. The Pro plan provides 500 songs per month, royalty-free music, access to the v5.5 model, commercial use rights, priority generation, song editing, and stem separation. The Premier plan includes 2,000 songs per month, access to Suno Studio, multitrack editing, MIDI export, Persona Voices, and early access to new features.

The company faces significant intellectual property litigation. As of the held facts, Suno is a defendant in eight lawsuits including cases in Massachusetts, Texas, New York, and Illinois. Notable cases include UMG Recordings and Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc., as well as individual cases including Gawronski v. Suno Inc., Rugnetta v. Suno, Inc., Pilavian v. Suno, Inc., Reyna v. Suno, Inc., S.A. Jamendo v. Suno Inc., Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc., and Woulard v. Suno, Inc. Massachusetts accounts for 97 of the tracked legal exposures.
